behaviour-switch.answer: The switch (DialectBehavior.IndexedReadPreviousAfterOpenAtEnd, src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Runtime/IO/IndexedConnector.cs#SelectSequentialRecord) decides only which record §2002:14.8.29.3 GR18 selects for a READ PREVIOUS that is the first operation after OPEN on an indexed file. GR15 governs an unsuccessful READ 'unless otherwise specified'; an at-end READ PREVIOUS after OPEN is 'otherwise specified' by GR18's no-record sentence (FPI set to no next or previous record), so the switched case falls under GR18, not GR15. The reader's evidence (read-gr15-unsucc.cob, pb338/pb359) uses random miss, at end on a sequential file, lock limit and START; pb338_read_lock_limit_position and pb359 execute no READ PREVIOUS (grep). No change. Lead, not this row: at --std 2002 the switch returns the lowest record (probe prev-open-ix.cob: P1=K002|00) where §2002:14.8.26.3 GR12 (FPI = lowest-ordinal characters) with §2002:14.8.29.3 GR18c2 (key less than or equal to the FPI) find no record, so '10' and at end; that is a GR18 defect.
